::: {#exr-twice}
#### A function as an argument

The function `twice` takes a function `f` and a value `x`:

```racket
(define (twice f x)
  (f (f x)))

(define (add-three x)
  (+ x 3))
```

Guess what each expression returns:

1. `(twice add-three 10)`
2. `(twice h 4)`, with `h` from @exr-formula-from-code
3. `(twice add-three (twice add-three 0))`

:::
